annotations.title: Find where a name is declared

description: Locate the declarations of an exact identifier: every function or type with that name, and nothing else. This is not a substring or full-text search — it will not match call sites, comments, or strings, which is why it is drastically cheaper than grep for the question "where is X defined?" (measured 97.98% fewer bytes across ten identifiers, docs/names-cost.md). Use `search_code` instead when you only know roughly what you are after.

kind.description: Restrict results to functions or types. Defaults to all.

name.description: The exact identifier to look up.

name: find_definition
title: Find where a name is declared
